claim: Many men think sexual stamina is extremely complex, maybe even mystical or unattainable
Some Kegel apps advertised on social media suggest the opposite of stamina being complex, that Kegels alone give powerful control
About sexual stamina, the truth is in between: all the techniques and nuances boil down to three dials
Understanding what the three dials of sexual stamina are and how they relate to each other gives you the foundation you need for significant changes and improvements in your control
Why sexual stamina matters
Sexual stamina matters for more pleasure: better control means more pleasure
Sexual stamina matters for managing sexual energy and semen retention: to harness that force, you need to choose when or if you ejaculate
Sexual stamina matters for a deeper, more meaningful connection with your partner
Dial 1 of sexual stamina: the pelvic floor, or root muscle, a group of muscles treated as one
In the moment, the pelvic floor dial of sexual stamina mostly comes down to keeping the pelvic floor relaxed, even at high arousal
Tension in the root muscle, and especially involuntary contractions, are a primary cause of premature ejaculation
With weak erections, a lot of men run into a tendency to squeeze the pelvic floor to hold or strengthen the erection
Relaxing the pelvic floor at high arousal requires strong erections, which many factors can affect, from sleep to food, weight and stress
Strong erections also need a strong pelvic floor, so Kegels matter
A strong root muscle gives stronger erections, a stronger libido and more sexual charge
Practice for the pelvic floor dial of sexual stamina: Kegels and reverse Kegels (more in the show's archive), with a relaxed pelvic floor as the base state you return to
For the pelvic floor dial of sexual stamina, notice involuntary contractions and release them, over and over
Dial 2 of sexual stamina: the breath, where things start to kind of get away from what most guys have maybe thought about or might be aware of
name: Breathing

claim: Breath shapes the balance of the nervous system between the parasympathetic (restful) and sympathetic (fight or flight) states
name: Breathing

claim: The nervous system is never fully parasympathetic or sympathetic, always a balance, and breath is one of the strongest factors in where it lands
name: Breathing

claim: The sympathetic (fight or flight) side of the nervous system brings muscle tension and more automatic body responses, so less conscious control, and it reduces focus and presence
name: Breathing

claim: A relaxed pelvic floor is very hard in the sympathetic (fight or flight) state
name: Breathing

claim: The parasympathetic (restful) side of the nervous system brings presence, conscious control and relaxed muscles
name: Breathing

claim: As few as two or three short, shallow, rapid chest breaths can push you toward fight or flight, and a couple of minutes of it can really push you further
name: Breathing

claim: If short, shallow, rapid chest breathing is your default as arousal rises, or as sex starts, you get tension, a harder time relaxing the pelvic floor, less presence and less control
name: Breathing

claim: Deep, slow, nasal breathing moves you toward the restful state
name: Breathing

claim: Practice for the breath dial of sexual stamina
Notice your breathing moment to moment
name: Breathing

claim: Few people pay attention to or train their breathing, though breath is literally what gives us life
name: Breathing

claim: Breathing on its own doesn't mean breathing well, or in a way that supports control, or your being at your best: maximum energy, charge, focus and sexual control
name: Breathing

claim: Stay in nasal breathing, lips sealed, at high arousal and during exercise
name: Breathing

claim: Staying in nasal breathing, lips sealed, alone slows and deepens the breath
name: Breathing

claim: Practice for the breath: breath work of any kind, from box breathing to Wim Hof breathing, with many books on it
name: Breathing

claim: In edging sessions, notice at 7, 8 or 9 on the arousal scale whether your breath gets fast and shallow, and consciously slow it down
name: Breathing

claim: Dial 3 of sexual stamina: awareness, which even fewer men think about or practice
Awareness, dial 3 of sexual stamina, is "more powerful than you can possibly imagine"

Presence, for the awareness dial of sexual stamina: awareness caught in anxious thoughts, stress, another place and time, or porn disconnects you from your body, so you can't manage your breath or your pelvic floor
The moment, for the awareness dial of sexual stamina: are you truly aware of your partner, of what you feel, of the energy moving between you, and of what happens in your body?
Inside the body, "where your awareness goes, energy flows"
Focusing on a part of the body tends to bring sensation there and, in essence, channels energy toward it
By habit, many men's awareness goes directly to the point of stimulation, the sexual center
If awareness is overly focused on the sexual center, all the energy channels there, and it can hold only so much before it overflows
Instead of the sexual center alone, bring awareness to the sacrum, spine, crown of the head or soles of the feet

With awareness on the sacrum, spine, crown of the head or soles of the feet, you feel sensation there and channel energy through the whole body, which can hold vastly more sexual energy than the sexual center alone
Practice for the awareness dial of sexual stamina: be present through the day, letting go of past and future and getting out of your head
Meditate: its benefits "cannot possibly" be overstated
Meditation teaches you where your awareness is and how to place it
In edging and sex, check: am I present or off in a fantasy, and where in my body is my awareness?
For the awareness dial of sexual stamina, how you practice matters less than practicing
Sort everything you have practiced or heard about sexual control into the three dials of sexual stamina, since everything about sexual control falls into one of them
During sex, the three dials of sexual stamina are the three things to tune into moment by moment
All three dials of sexual stamina are needed. One is not enough
You can do all the Kegels you want, build a strong pelvic floor and even relax it at high arousal, and still lack control without breath and awareness
If a ton of Kegels seem to make no difference at all to your control, part of the reason is most likely missing breath and awareness
Even with two out of three dials of sexual stamina, losing the breath into short, shallow breathing tenses everything and you release when you don't want to
Good is good enough: no dial of sexual stamina needs mastery
A favorite phrase: in life, good is good enough 90%, maybe 99%, of the time
name: Good enough, not perfect

claim: Perfectionism is a common trap
name: Good enough, not perfect

claim: What good-enough control of each dial of sexual stamina looks like
Good-enough control of the pelvic floor, for sexual stamina: strong enough for strong erections, relaxed at high arousal
Good-enough control of the breath, for sexual stamina: avoid short, shallow, rapid breathing, without needing "magical" slow breathing
name: Breathing

claim: Good-enough control of awareness, for sexual stamina: not totally lost, with some sense of where it is in the body and a good ability to stay present with yourself and your partner
With good-enough control of all three dials of sexual stamina, you will have all the control you want, choosing if or when you ejaculate no matter how high arousal gets
A lot of men say they get discouraged as years go by, they try so many things for sexual control and nothing seems to work

Sexual control absolutely can change, "I promise you": understand the three dials of sexual stamina and start to develop better control over them, and you can have limitless control, no matter what's happening with your partner
Keep stacking bricks: the biggest, most beautiful castles are built one small brick at a time, and so are life and sexual stamina
